Issued 2025-04-03. Section 4(a)(i): within 365 days of issuance agencies must document implementation of the minimum practices for high-impact uses and be prepared to report to OMB; non-compliant use must be safely discontinued. Pilot programs meeting stated conditions are exempt.

Binding on executive branch departments and agencies of the US federal government (intelligence community elements exempt from Sections 4(a) to (b)).
